title: Demo requests and internal research freeze a canonical place profile with host-owned fact assessments
steps: S1: Run the fact-assessment and profile-revision unit suites.
S2: On the test Postgres, run the public-demos and place-profile-freeze suites: submit v2, build its revision, replay, mutate live research, and create another revision.
expect: S1: Sender-sensitive assertions and reviews are withheld, stale facts are marked, profile hashes use the original canonical JSON, and changed facts do not inherit assessment.
S2: Both revision paths freeze profile and assessment, v2 builds a valid brief and replays the same revision; oversized or assessment-smuggled requests are refused before import.
